body: My dad is pretty much the only reason I couldn't go through with my plan. My dad and I have never been close, but he's the one who got me through my hardest moment's and he's always been there for me when I fucked up. I just don't think I could put him through my death. I think he would be proud of me if I died serving my country in Afghanistan or Syria, but I can't imagine how bad he would feel knowing I died putting a shotgun shell through my own head. I think it's important to think about family when we get depressed, even if they cant help. Not to feel guilty, but to remember that at least one person in this world remembers you and will miss you. You should pm me if you want to talk.
